description: The NTHF combination catalogue (121 named moves for the centre and the right wing), parsed from references/combinations/puck-no-combination-catalogue-en.html. Names, positions, difficulty (0-10) and descriptions are NTHF's, unchanged. See docs/table-hockey-playbook.md.

terms.forward/back: NTHF defines 'forward' and 'back' as the ends of the board nearest and furthest from the player, but its example (the centre is near the opponent's goalie when it stands forward in the slot) needs forward = toward the opponent's goal. Unresolved (docs/table-hockey-playbook.md, Open 5).
terms.fakie: the mirror version (usually from the other side, e.g. left instead of right)
terms.invers: the same trick in the opposite order
terms.-o suffix: usually a harder variant of the trick without the o
terms.not in bold on the site: the author doubts a goal has been scored with it in an official match

combinations.name: Näcka
combinations.description: Center starts with the puck in the heel groove, passes with the heel a few centimeters out to the right, and shoots with the blade into the right corner

combinations.name: Spjass
combinations.description: Center starts with the puck in the heel groove, passes with the blade a few centimeters out to the left, spins all the way around and shoots with the blade into the left corner

combinations.name: Lillhæl
combinations.description: Center starts with the puck in the heel groove, passes with the blade about one centimeter out to the left, and shoots with the heel into the left corner

combinations.name: Lillstøvel
combinations.description: Center starts with the puck in the toe groove, passes with the toe a few centimeters out to the left, and shoots with the blade into the left corner. Named after the legendary Djurgården player Carl-Göran 'Lill-Stöveln' Öberg, younger brother of Hans 'Stöveln' Öberg

combinations.name: Omvendspjass
combinations.description: Center starts with the puck in the toe groove, passes with the blade a few centimeters out to the right, spins all the way around and shoots with the blade into the right corner

combinations.name: Fakie Näcka
combinations.description: Center starts with the puck in the toe groove, quickly shifts to having the puck in the heel groove, and performs a Näcka

combinations.name: Fakie Spjass
combinations.description: Center starts with the puck in the toe groove, quickly shifts to having the puck in the heel groove, and performs a Spjass

combinations.name: Fakie Lillstøvel
combinations.description: Center starts with the puck in the heel groove, quickly shifts to having the puck in the toe groove, and performs a Lillstøvel

combinations.name: Fakie Omvendspjass
combinations.description: Center starts with the puck in the heel groove, quickly shifts to having the puck in the toe groove, and performs an Omvendspjass

combinations.name: Hjerpe
combinations.description: Center starts with the puck out on the blade to the right of the slot, carries the puck over to the left side of the slot, and shoots into the left corner

combinations.name: Hjerpefinte
combinations.description: Center starts with the puck out on the blade to the right of the slot, and shoots directly into the right corner. Only works against a goalie expecting a Hjerpe

combinations.name: Søren
combinations.description: Center starts with the puck out on the blade to the left of the slot, carries the puck over to the right side of the slot, and shoots into the right corner. Named after the legendary table hockey and ice hockey player Sören Johansson, who did a similar feint in ice hockey

combinations.name: Sørenfinte
combinations.description: Center starts with the puck out on the blade to the left of the slot and shoots directly into the left corner. Only works against a goalie expecting a Søren

combinations.name: Senterkiosk
combinations.description: Center starts with the puck a couple of centimeters to the left of the slot and performs a Kiosk into the left or right top corner

combinations.name: Näckafinte
combinations.description: Center performs a Näcka, but places the puck in the left corner. Only works against a reacting goalie

combinations.name: Spjassfinte
combinations.description: Center performs a Spjass, but places the puck in the right corner. Only works against a reacting goalie

combinations.name: Lillstøvelfinte / C 29
combinations.description: Center performs a Lillstøvel, but places the puck in the right corner. Only works against a reacting goalie

combinations.name: Omvendspjassfinte
combinations.description: Center performs an Omvendspjass, but places the puck in the left corner. Only works against a reacting goalie

combinations.name: Senter-Ceuleman
combinations.description: Center shoots the puck from the toe groove via the right boards and into the goal behind (or via) the goalie

combinations.name: Fakie Senter-Ceuleman
combinations.description: Center shoots the puck from the heel groove via the left boards and into the goal behind (or via) the goalie

combinations.name: Horvath
combinations.description: Center starts with the puck a bit out on the blade to the right of the slot, shoots into the left rounded boards, gets the rebound, and shoots into the right corner

combinations.name: Fakie Horvath
combinations.description: Center shoots into the right boards behind the opponent's goal, gets the rebound, and shoots into the left corner

combinations.name: Spjass-Horvath
combinations.description: Center performs a Spjass, deliberately misses the goal and hits the left rounded boards, gets the rebound, and shoots into the right corner

combinations.name: Veggdyr
combinations.description: Center shoots the puck from the heel groove via the left boards, back to the center and into the goal

combinations.name: Fakie Veggdyr
combinations.description: Center shoots the puck from the toe groove via the right boards, back to the center and into the goal

combinations.name: Agdur
combinations.description: Pass from center to left wing, back to the center and into the right corner

combinations.name: Halv-Agdur
combinations.description: Pass from center to left wing, who shoots directly into the left corner

combinations.name: Agduro
combinations.description: Pass from center to left wing, who carries the puck backward in the slot and passes behind the opponent's center back to their own center at the very back of the slot and into the goal (see Sentrifugo)

combinations.name: Invers Agduro
combinations.description: Center carries the puck backward in the slot and passes behind the opponent's center to the left wing, who passes back to the center and into the goal

combinations.name: Invers Halv-Agduro
combinations.description: Center carries the puck backward in the slot and passes behind the opponent's center to the left wing, who shoots directly into the left corner

combinations.name: Fakie Agdur
combinations.description: Pass from center to right wing, back to the center and into the left corner

combinations.name: Fakie Halv-Agdur
combinations.description: Pass from center to right wing, who shoots directly into the goal

combinations.name: Fakie Invers Agduro
combinations.description: Center carries the puck backward in the slot and passes behind the opponent's left defenseman to the right wing, who carries the puck forward in the slot and passes in front of the opponent's left defenseman back to the center and into the goal

combinations.name: Fakie Invers Halv-Agduro
combinations.description: Center carries the puck backward in the slot and passes behind the opponent's left defenseman to the right wing, who shoots directly into the goal

combinations.name: Holmin
combinations.description: Center shoots into the boards at the start of the right rounded boards, so that the puck glides along the boards to the left wing, who shoots directly into the goal

combinations.name: Holms
combinations.description: Center shoots into the boards at the start of the right rounded boards, so that the puck glides along the boards to the left wing and on to the center, who shoots directly into the goal

combinations.name: Holms-Gretzky
combinations.description: Center shoots into the boards at the start of the right rounded boards, so that the puck glides along the boards to the left wing, who is placed just to the left of the opponent's goal and passes backward to the center, who shoots directly into the goal

combinations.name: Senter-Velodrom
combinations.description: Center passes to the left wing, who sends the puck in a Velodrom over to the right wing, who shoots directly into the right corner

combinations.name: Senter-Karusell
combinations.description: Center passes to the left wing, who sends the puck in a Velodrom over to the right wing and in to the center and into the goal

combinations.name: Fakie Senter-Velodrom
combinations.description: Center passes to the right wing, who sends the puck in a Velodrom over to the left wing, who shoots directly into the left corner

combinations.name: Fakie Senter-Karusell
combinations.description: Center passes to the right wing, who sends the puck in a Velodrom over to the left wing and in to the center and into the goal

combinations.name: Skalpell
combinations.description: Pass from center to the goalie, who shoots one-timed into the goal

combinations.name: General Reiersen
combinations.description: Pass from center along the right boards behind their own goal to the left defenseman, who shoots one-timed into the goal

combinations.name: Senterkniv
combinations.description: Pass from center to the left defenseman, who shoots one-timed into the goal

combinations.name: Senterknivo
combinations.description: Pass from center behind the opponent's center to the left defenseman, who shoots one-timed into the goal

combinations.name: Rambokniv
combinations.description: Pass from center to the left defenseman, who passes behind the opponent's center and in to their own center, who shoots one-timed from the very back of the slot

combinations.name: Fakie Senterkniv
combinations.description: Pass from center to the right defenseman, who shoots one-timed into the goal

combinations.name: Senter-Backnäcka
combinations.description: Pass from center to the right defenseman, who shoots around the opponent's left defenseman and into the goal (see Backnäcka)

combinations.name: Invers Kano
combinations.description: Pass from center via the right boards to the right defenseman, who shoots one-timed into the goal

combinations.name: Fakie Invers Kano
combinations.description: Pass from center via the left boards to the left defenseman, who shoots one-timed into the goal

combinations.name: Senter-Rokkade
combinations.description: Pass from center to the right defenseman and on to the left defenseman, who shoots one-timed into the goal

combinations.name: Fakie Senter-Rokkade
combinations.description: Pass from center to the left defenseman and on to the right defenseman, who shoots one-timed into the goal

combinations.name: Bacalao
combinations.description: Pass from center to the right defenseman, who shoots one-timed via the right boards and into the goal

combinations.name: Newton
combinations.description: Center shoots via the opponent's right defenseman and into the goal

combinations.name: Mission Impossible 3
combinations.description: Center plays the puck off the goal frame and puts the rebound into the goal

combinations.name: Direkteskudd
combinations.description: Right wing shoots directly into the goal, preferably lifting it into the top corner

combinations.name: Maltzev / Smygar
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck forward in the slot and shoots into the goal between the goalie and the right post

combinations.name: Bedehus-Smygar / Tysk Smygar
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck forward in the slot and shoots into the goal via the goalie's back

combinations.name: Fakie Forulemping
combinations.description: Right wing starts behind the opponent's goal, carries the puck backward in the slot and shoots between the goalie and the right post

combinations.name: Nuttunenslegga
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck backward in the slot, stops and shoots directly into the nearest top corner over the goalie's stick

combinations.name: Tønsbergslegga
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck forward in the slot, passes it a few centimeters to the left, spins around and shoots into the goal in motion

combinations.name: EMoe-smyger
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck in the outer stick groove forward in the slot and shoots into the goal in motion

combinations.name: Lønnskipp
combinations.description: The puck lies near the right wing, who shoots directly into the top corner with lift

combinations.name: Tomahawk
combinations.description: Right wing stands far back in the slot and shoots via the right boards and into the goal

combinations.name: Fakie Tomahawk
combinations.description: Right wing shoots via the left boards and into the goal

combinations.name: Brustadbu
combinations.description: Right wing scores with a kiosk shot

combinations.name: Lille Trille
combinations.description: Right wing scores with a weak kiosk shot that rolls into the left corner

combinations.name: Smygero
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck quickly forward along the boards and flicks the puck into the goal between the goalie and the right post

combinations.name: Invers Smygero / Eidsneskølle
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck quickly backward along the boards, goes past the puck and shoots with a set blade into the goal

combinations.name: Fakie Jon Spesial / Korabel
combinations.description: Right wing shoots via the blade of a stationary center and into the left corner of the goal

combinations.name: Hagerup
combinations.description: Right wing and center stand at the very back of the slot, and the right wing passes in to the center, who shoots directly into the right corner

combinations.name: Spade
combinations.description: Right wing and center stand at the very back of the slot, and the right wing passes in to the center, who shoots directly into the left corner

combinations.name: Lindahlskyffel kort
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck forward in the slot and passes in to the center, who shoots into the right corner

combinations.name: Lindahlskyffel lang
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck forward in the slot and passes in to the center, who shoots into the left corner

combinations.name: Edwallskyffel kort
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck forward in the slot with the heel groove and passes in to the center, who shoots into the right corner

combinations.name: Edwallskyffel lang
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck forward in the slot with the heel groove and passes in to the center, who shoots into the left corner

combinations.name: Hælskyffel kort
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck backward in the slot with the stick groove and passes in with the heel to the center, who shoots into the right corner. Can also be performed with a blade pass

combinations.name: Hælskyffel lang
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck backward in the slot with the stick groove and passes in with the heel to the center, who shoots into the left corner. Can also be performed with a blade pass

combinations.name: Tryykari kort
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck quickly forward in the slot with the heel groove (Edwall drag), stops and performs a heel shovel into the near corner

combinations.name: Tryykari lang
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck quickly forward in the slot with the heel groove (Edwall drag), stops and performs a heel shovel into the far corner

combinations.name: Tryykarifinte
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck quickly forward in the slot with the heel groove (Edwall drag), stops before the goal line, turns 180 degrees counterclockwise and shoots with the heel into the goal

combinations.name: Gangsøyskyffel kort
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck quickly backward along the boards, spins around counterclockwise and passes in to the center, who shoots into the right corner

combinations.name: Gangsøyskyffel lang
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck quickly backward along the boards, spins around counterclockwise and passes in to the center, who shoots into the left corner

combinations.name: Truls
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck on the outside of the blade backward and passes in to the center, who scores

combinations.name: Wilkens
combinations.description: Right wing pretends to drag the puck backward, stops, and passes in forward to the center, who scores

combinations.name: Pettersonskyffel
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck forward in the slot, goes slightly past the puck, spins clockwise and passes in to the center, who scores

combinations.name: Furious G
combinations.description: Smygero with a pass to the center, who scores

combinations.name: Marcus Andersson
combinations.description: Right shovel directly into the right corner

combinations.name: Fakie Harlem Shuffle
combinations.description: Right wing passes to the center, who with a swinging blade flicks the puck into the goal

combinations.name: Veggskyffel
combinations.description: Right wing stands far forward in the slot with the puck and shoots via the right boards to the center, who scores

combinations.name: Fakie Velodrom
combinations.description: Pass from the right wing along the boards behind the goal to the left wing, who shoots into the left corner

combinations.name: Fakie Karusell
combinations.description: Pass from the right wing along the boards behind the goal to the left wing, who passes in to the center, who scores

combinations.name: Snok / Mexikaner
combinations.description: Right wing shoots the puck via the boards to the center, who shoots directly into the goal

combinations.name: Snik
combinations.description: Right wing shoots the puck via the goalie to the center, who shoots directly into the goal

combinations.name: Fakie kniv
combinations.description: Pass from right wing to the right defenseman, who shoots directly into the goal

combinations.name: Fakie lang-kniv
combinations.description: Pass from right wing to the left defenseman, who shoots directly into the goal

combinations.name: Langorv
combinations.description: Pass from right wing along the boards behind the goal so that the puck ends up with the left defenseman, who shoots directly into the goal

combinations.name: Invers Kryssar
combinations.description: Pass from right wing to left wing, who shoots into the left corner

combinations.name: Invers Kryssar med innspill
combinations.description: Pass from right wing to left wing, who sends it on to the center, who scores

combinations.name: Invers Kryssar med Velodrom
combinations.description: Pass from right wing to left wing, who passes along the boards behind the goal to the right wing, who shoots directly into the goal

combinations.name: Invers Kryssar med Karusell
combinations.description: Pass from right wing to left wing, who passes along the boards behind the goal to the right wing, who sends it in to the center, who scores

combinations.name: Fakie Lang-Agdur
combinations.description: Pass from right wing to left wing, who sends it back to the right wing, who shoots directly into the goal

combinations.name: Nuttunen
combinations.description: Pass from right wing to the left defenseman and on to the center, who scores from far back in the slot

combinations.name: Nuttunen goes useless
combinations.description: Pass from right wing to the center far back in the slot, who flicks it on to the left defenseman, who shoots directly into the goal

combinations.name: Reiersen
combinations.description: Pass from right wing along the right boards behind their own goal to the left defenseman, who shoots directly into the goal

combinations.name: Reiersen på bærtur
combinations.description: Pass from right wing along the right boards behind their own goal to the left defenseman, who sends it behind their own goal to the right defenseman, who shoots directly into the goal

combinations.name: Gretzky
combinations.description: Pass from right wing along the boards behind the goal to the left wing, who sends it backward to the center, who scores

combinations.name: Fakie Mors Kök / Fars Kök
combinations.description: Pass from right wing at the very front of the slot via the left rounded boards to the center, who scores

combinations.name: Burkgurk
combinations.description: Pass from right wing along the boards behind their own goal to the left wing, who flicks directly into the left corner

combinations.name: Burkgurkskyffel
combinations.description: Pass from right wing along the boards behind their own goal to the left wing, who sends it on to the center, who scores

combinations.name: Jorda Rundt
combinations.description: Pass from right wing along the boards behind their own goal and all the way around back to the right wing, who shoots directly into the goal

combinations.name: Jorda Rundt-skyffel
combinations.description: Pass from right wing along the boards behind their own goal and all the way around back to the right wing, who sends it to the center, who scores

combinations.name: Fakie Gutshot
combinations.description: Pass from right wing to the goalie, who shoots directly into the goal

combinations.name: Fakie Gutshot-Hansen
combinations.description: Pass from right wing to the goalie, who sends it back to the right wing, who shoots into the right corner

combinations.name: Invers Rookierokkade
combinations.description: Pass from right wing far back in the slot to the right defenseman, who sends it back to the right wing, who scores

combinations.name: Fakie Zorro
combinations.description: Pass from right wing to center, on to the right defenseman, and finally to the left defenseman, who shoots directly into the goal

combinations.name: Mission Impossible 2
combinations.description: Right wing sends the puck along the boards to the left wing, who sends it directly to the center, who scores

combinations.name: Edwall-innspill
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck forward in the slot with the heel groove and sends it in to the center

combinations.name: Lindahl-innspill
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck forward in the slot with the stick groove and sends it in to the center

combinations.name: Østerman-innspill
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck quickly forward in the slot, turns 180 degrees counterclockwise, stops, spins back and sends the puck in to the center

combinations.name: Silis-innspill
combinations.description: Right wing carries the puck quickly backward in the slot with the heel groove and sends it in to the center in motion
